name: tell_me
title: Section C · an agent's run stays out of the stream, until the person asks to be told

steps.result: This is my first run: the Listings table has **2 listings**, Harbour Car Wash (£850,000) and Corner Print Shop (£210,000). From next Monday I'll list any new ones by name.

steps.say: From now on, tell me here whenever Listing Watch finds a new listing.
steps.reply:
Done. Each time Listing Watch finds a new listing, it will tell you here by name. Until now its results only went on its own page.

It next runs on **Monday 26 October at 09:00**, or when your Mac next wakes if it's asleep then. It already knows about your two current listings, Harbour Car Wash and Corner Print Shop, so you'll only hear about new ones. This is saved as a standing instruction, so if you want it to stop, just say so.

steps.result: There's 1 new listing since my last run: **Lakeside Bakery** (£450,000). That makes 3 in the table now.
